params.zh-CN: 传给 lottie-web loadAnimation 的参数。内容变化时重新加载，原地修改不会触发：请整体替换，较大的动画数据用 shallowRef 持有。
params.en-US: Options passed to lottie-web's loadAnimation. It reloads when the content changes, not when the object is mutated in place: replace it as a whole, and hold large animation data in a shallowRef.

width.en-US: Container width, with a unit such as 300px.

height.en-US: Container height, with a unit such as 300px.

getAnimationInstance.zh-CN: 每创建一次动画（包括每次重新加载）触发一次，载荷为当前动画的 AnimationItem。
getAnimationInstance.en-US: Emitted once per animation created, including every reload, with the AnimationItem of the animation.

getLottie.zh-CN: lottie-web 加载完成后，每次挂载触发一次，载荷为全局 Lottie。
getLottie.en-US: Emitted once per mount after lottie-web has loaded, with the global Lottie.
